summary: Iteration 12 — Backend + Frontend E2E for rentals price_history / PATCH price / admin CRUD + persistence across backend restart. All 10 pytest tests pass. Frontend admin flow verified end-to-end: Rentals tab → click price on row opens PriceHistoryModal → enters new price + reason → Save PATCHes /api/admin/rentals/{id}/price → toast 'Price updated to $269.23' → row price updates → history table shows the new entry (old $65 → new $269.23 with reason & admin@roxtaxi.com). EditModal Add flow shows year/make/model/color/body/seats. /rentals blackout dates use font-bold. /taxi and /tours pages load (200).

issues: 'Featured on home' checkbox (data-testid='edit-featured') is intentionally hidden when kind==='rentals' (see AdminManage.jsx line 260 `{!isRental && …}`). The review request lists 'featured checkbox' as expected for the rental EditModal, so if featured rentals should surface on home, remove the `!isRental` guard. Otherwise this is by-design and just needs a note in the spec.

action_items: Decide whether the 'Featured on home' checkbox should also be available for rentals in the EditModal (currently hidden for kind==='rentals').

Note: seed-item prices are admin-mutable and persist across restarts by design ($setOnInsert). During E2E, spark-compact's price was bumped to $269.23 then reverted to $65 for cleanup. Consider a UI affordance to 'reset to seed default' if that matters.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py PATCH /admin/{kind}/{item_id}/price correctly guards zero/negative (422) and identical (400).
admin_create_item / admin_update_item both push to price_history with admin_email + timestamp — good audit trail.
PriceHistoryModal.load() uses api client (baseURL={REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api) so URL routing via ingress is correct.
AdminManage.jsx is ~1026 lines — consider splitting PriceHistoryModal, EditModal, ImagePickerModal into separate files (>700-line threshold).
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned up several TEST_ prefixed rentals/tours/taxi_services during backend tests. Also mutated spark-compact price during E2E ($65 → $269.23 → reverted to $65).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend restart-persistence test PASSES — admin-added rentals survive `supervisorctl restart backend` (delete_many removed from seed_db, prices seeded via $setOnInsert). PriceHistoryModal + PATCH /price endpoint fully working across all three kinds (rentals, tours, taxi_services). Seed rental prices are now user-mutable and persistent — do NOT expect a fresh $65 spark-compact after restart.
rca of the issue: First E2E run failed an assertion because the PriceHistoryModal auto-closes after Save (via onSaved()), so 'rows_after' was 0 (component unmounted). Test logic issue only — actual functionality worked (toast + row price updated visible in screenshot). Second E2E confirmed the history table contains the new entry after re-opening the modal.
